t: The $(thing)Drone Condition: Upgrades/$ widget lets you check the number of installed upgrades in this $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$. Specify the upgrade(s) to be checked by using one or more attached $(l:programming/item_filter)Item Filter/$ widgets, set to the upgrade item(s) to be checked; without any filter, all installed upgrades of all types will be counted.
$(thing)无人机条件：升级/$组件可让你检查此$(l:tools/drone)无人机/$中已安装的升级数量。使用一个或多个附加的$(l:programming/item_filter)物品过滤器/$组件，并将其设置为要检查的升级物品，即可指定要检查的升级；如果不使用任何过滤器，则会统计所有类型的全部已安装升级。
